observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is friendly, encouraging, and breaks down tricks step-by-step in an outdoor garden setting. She uses descriptive imagery like 'driving' and 'basketball' to explain hand positions.

lesson_structure.note: welcomes viewers and introduces beginner hoop tricks
teaches duck out of hula hoop

common_mistakes: putting hand on top instead of underneath during isolation

steps_taught.name: Isolation Hooping
steps_taught.description: Keep hand underneath and move in a circle while keeping the hoop in the same position.

steps_taught.name: The Vortex
steps_taught.description: Spin hoop, wrap it, bring it above you, and guide it around your body.

steps_taught.name: Duck Out
steps_taught.description: Duck your head through the hoop as it hits your back.

steps_taught.name: Basketball Isolation
steps_taught.description: Isolation with hand on top of the hoop making a steering wheel motion.

steps_taught.name: Lasso
steps_taught.description: Spin the hoop above your head and bring it down in a circle in front of you.

what_works: clear visual demonstrations of hand placements
breaking down tricky maneuvers into slower steps
what_hinders: some transitions between steps lack detailed explanations

quotes.text: you're going to want to pretend like you are driving.
how to duck out of the hula hoop
I hope it helps you get into hula hooping

teacher demonstrates the vortex trick moving the hoop around her body

extraction.distinctive_method: uses common everyday analogies like driving a car and playing basketball to explain hand coordination.
